who.value: Professional seller viewing their own profile

job.value: see how their store looks and reach their seller tools

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: The header, ratings and bio read as a public store profile, but 'Edit profile' and the Balance/Purchases/Sales shortcuts make it an owner dashboard too, so the purpose is mixed.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: 'Edit profile' is the widest button, while the eight shortcut tiles and voucher cards compete equally below it.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Balance', 'Sales', 'Insights' predict well, but 'See all' (as a tile) and 'Caroubiz' don't say where they lead.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Caroubiz', 'Cart (beta)' and 'Certified Partner' appear with no explanation.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: Nothing is asked of the seller.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: The bio is cut with 'more' and extra tools are behind 'See all'.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: The 'Spend $15, get 5% off' vouchers are buyer-facing offers shown next to the seller's own Balance and Sales tools.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Ratings, counts and tile labels carry it; the bio is two lines with 'more'.
